bh_classic.BH_source_adaptation: Matched GNAN consumes frozen parent stereo/Pd chemistry, not altered author processed molecules

yieldbert.initialization: RXNFP bert_pretrained MLM; fresh scalar regression head, not bert_ft
yieldbert.optimizer: Official Transformers2.11 AdamW, correct_bias=True, decay0, epsilon1e-8; linear schedule, no warmup
yieldbert.checkpoint: lowest validation MSE for matched; final fixed epoch for source-protocol
yieldbert.training_mode: Call model.train() once before all epochs; evaluation sets eval mode and train mode is never restored, reproducing historical SimpleTransformers0.34.4 effective behavior
yieldbert.evaluation_cadence: Every2000 optimizer steps and every epoch end on MATCHED validation rows only
yieldbert.target_scale: Same matched-training population standard deviation as v2; original author pandas sample std differs slightly

yieldbert_da.augmentation: 15 rotated SMILES + independently shuffled precursor components per fit-training row; no chemistry changes
yieldbert_da.source: rxn_yields augmentation.randomize_smiles, plus explicit component shuffling
yieldbert_da.validation: canonical inputs, same validation rows; no label-dependent augmentation
yieldbert_da.primary_test: 10 deterministic chemistry-preserving variants averaged; canonical prediction retained separately
yieldbert_da.training_mode: Same source-effective mode and2000-step evaluation cadence as YieldBERT; first augmented epoch can cross2000 before epoch end

gnan.architecture: unmodified author model.reactionMPNN and data/get_data.py featurizer
gnan.optimizer: author AdamW.001 decay.05 warmup10 cosine to1e-5
gnan.loss: author squared error+heteroscedastic and three additive regularizers
gnan.validation: every10epochs with5MC dropout passes; lowest validation MSE matched, final500epoch source-protocol
gnan.clipping: primary matched predictions unbounded, classic clipped secondary retained; NCS never clipped

task: continuous regression; NCS is exploratory mixed-assay extension, not paper success classification
evaluation: controller alone reads test outcomes after saved predictions; exact parent common-valid rows
limits: New matched adapters do not reproduce legacy SimpleTransformers numerics bit for bit
2026 MFP paper gives inconsistent BH test count830 versus actual1188 and misidentifies GNANcitation; use pinned source population
15-training/10-test DA variant budget is explicit; 2026 manuscript leaves K and TTA count unspecified
No role normalization that changes ~ bonds or dative chemistry is permitted in matched inputs
GNAN author BH molecules omit ligand stereo and use a different Pd drawing; new matched inputs keep parent chemistry
Classical source-protocol comparisons use full70%training fixedepochs and are separate from matched validation-heldout fits
Modern HuggingFace forward remains numerical adaptation; the historical high-dropout effective mode schedule is explicitly reproduced and validated
correction: Replay the source-effective SimpleTransformers0.34.4 training-mode transitions and legacy Transformers2.11 AdamW; old v2 BERT fits remain provisional and excluded
correction_basis: Audited source and a fresh fixed-recipe train/validation-only learning gate; no test-score recipe selection
